nodes.label: DetectionApi abstract base
nodes.rationale: Every detector subclass declares type_key and implements detect_raw, which is how plugin auto-registration and the (20,6) detection contract are enforced across wildly different hardware backends.

nodes.label: DetectionApi.calculate_grids_strides
nodes.rationale: Shared YOLOX anchor grid/stride precomputation for strides 8/16/32; the expanded flag switches between flat concatenated grids (ONNX/OpenVINO) and per-level lists (RKNN).

nodes.label: 20x6 float32 detection array contract
nodes.rationale: Every detector returns a fixed np.zeros((20,6), float32) array ordered [class_id, score, y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] with coordinates normalized to 0..1 and padded to exactly 20 rows, so the object detection process can treat all hardware backends identically and use a fixed-size shared memory buffer.

hyperedges.label: Uniform (20,6) detection output across hardware backends
